description: A night graveyard seen at ground level. A large rounded grey headstone stands in the centre of the upper half, cracked across the top and carved with a few lines of worn, unreadable lettering; two smaller headstones stand behind it to either side. Everything else is pitch black, with a faint dotted line marking the edge of the grave plot. A tiny pair of red eyes glints in the dark at the upper right. White skeletal hands with faint green highlights claw up out of the earth in front of the stone. The mood is quiet dread. Frame 1: the ground is empty, held a moment. Frame 2: two bony hands burst from the soil, fingers spread. Frame 3: long forearms stretch high and the hands cross and grasp at the air. Frame 4: the arms sink slightly, hands still crossed. Frame 5: the arms pull back to the spread-fingered pose. Frame 6: only fingertips poke from the soil, held a little longer. The loop reads as a dead thing clawing up, groping, and sinking back into the grave.
title: Skeletal hands rising from grave
